verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm a served llms.txt (HTTP 200) at docs.speechischeap.com that summarizes the agent-facing surfaces (Jobs, x402, Edge and MCP). Probes also confirm markdown versions of doc pages (.md) and a machine-readable openapi.json, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant and of how completely the llms.txt index covers the whole doc set.
